In quantum theory events unfold in a fixed order while in general relativity temporal order is influenced by the distribution of matter. When matter requires a quantum description, temporal order is expected to become non-classical\u2014a scenario beyond the scope of current theories. Here we provide a direct description of such a scenario. We consider a thought experiment with a massive body in a spatial superposition and show how it leads to entanglement of temporal orders between time-like events. This entanglement enables accomplishing a task, violation of a Bell inequality, that is impossible under local classical temporal order; it means that temporal order cannot be described by any pre-defined local variables. A classical notion of a causal structure is therefore untenable in any framework compatible with the basic principles of quantum mechanics and classical general relativity.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1038\/s41467-019-11579-x","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2019,8,21]],"date-time":"2019-08-21T10:02:54Z","timestamp":1566381774000},"update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1007\/springer_crossmark_policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":132,"title":["Bell\u2019s theorem for temporal order"],"prefix":"10.1038","volume":"10","author":[{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-8356-7613","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Magdalena","family":"Zych","sequence":"first","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-6547-6005","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Fabio","family":"Costa","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-9441-2553","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Igor","family":"Pikovski","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"\u010caslav","family":"Brukner","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"297","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2019,8,21]]},"reference":[{"key":"11579_CR1","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","first-page":"195","DOI":"10.1103\/PhysicsPhysiqueFizika.1.195","volume":"1","author":"JS Bell","year":"1964","unstructured":"Bell, J.
